result.topic_en: A page of formula-only calculations: the square of a quartic expression in x, y is written as a product of four factors of the form (product of linear terms) + λ(x−y), and differences of these factors are computed.
result.transcription:
$\left((x+\alpha)(x+\alpha')(y+\alpha'')(y+\alpha''') + (x-y)(a\,xy + bx + cy + d)\right)^2$
$= \left((x+\alpha)(y+\alpha'') + \lambda(x-y)\right)\left((x+\alpha')(y+\alpha''') + \lambda'(x-y)\right)\left((x+\alpha)(y+\alpha''') + \lambda''(x-y)\right)\left((x+\alpha')(y+\alpha'') + \lambda'''(x-y)\right)$

[-$\xi\eta + \lambda f$-]
$\overset{(1)}{\xi\eta + \lambda f}$ $\overset{(2)}{\xi'\eta' + \lambda' f}$ $\overset{(3)}{\xi\eta' + \lambda'' f}$ $\overset{(4)}{\xi'\eta + \lambda''' f}$

[-$\xi \lambda' \xi$-] $(1)\lambda'' - (3)\lambda = \xi(\eta\lambda'' - \eta'\lambda)$
$(1)\lambda''' - (4)\lambda = \eta(\xi\lambda''' - \xi'\lambda)$
$(2)\lambda'' - (3)\lambda' = \eta'(\lambda''\xi' - \lambda'\xi)$
$(2)\lambda''' - (4)\lambda' = \xi'(\lambda'''\eta' - \lambda'\eta)$

methods.what: Factorization of the square of a quartic expression in x, y into four factors, each a product of linear terms plus a multiple of (x−y)
Abbreviated notation for the four factors, using ξ, ξ', η, η' for the linear factors and f for x−y
Linear combinations of pairs of factors that eliminate f, so each combination factors as a linear form times an expression
Further eliminations of f between pairs of factors
